native_form.query:
WITH ids AS (
    SELECT reference_id FROM prod_silver_db.logistics.serviceability_eta_details
    GROUP BY reference_id
    HAVING MIN(created_at) >= '2026-10-23 10:00:00 +0530'::TIMESTAMP_TZ
       AND MIN(created_at) <  '2026-10-23 10:00:30 +0530'::TIMESTAMP_TZ
)
SELECT 'V' AS src, d.reference_id, TO_VARCHAR(d.version) AS version, d.request_id AS request_id, TO_VARCHAR(d.created_at) AS ts1, TO_VARCHAR(d.sdd_enabled) AS val, NULL AS ts2, NULL AS ts3
FROM prod_silver_db.logistics.serviceability_eta_details d JOIN ids USING (reference_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'E', i.reference_id, NULL, i.request_id, TO_VARCHAR(i.created_at), i.result_selected_candidate_type, NULL, NULL
FROM prod_silver_db.logistics.logistics_eta_instrumentation i JOIN ids USING (reference_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'S', s.reference_id, TO_VARCHAR(s.version), NULL, NULL, TO_VARCHAR(s.is_deleted), TO_VARCHAR(s.pickup_time), TO_VARCHAR(s.first_delivery_attempt_time)
FROM prod_silver_db.logistics.logistics_shipment_details s JOIN ids USING (reference_id)
ORDER BY 2, 1, 5
